style: mandarin pop, female vocal, warm acoustic guitar, soft drums, clear diction, mid tempo
lyrics:
[Verse]
晚风轻轻吹过窗前
你留下的笑还在昨天
街灯把影子拉得很长
我数着星星回到起点

[Chorus]
让这首歌陪你走远
把所有想念唱成明天
就算世界暂时安静
我们还有这一段旋律

style: english indie rock, male vocal, distorted electric guitar, driving drums, raw and energetic
lyrics:
[Verse]
City lights are dimming slow
Footsteps echo where the lost ones go
Every shadow tells a story untold
I'm chasing something pure as gold

[Chorus]
Hold on, hold on, through the night we rise
Like a phoenix under endless skies
Every tear becomes a song
Where we belong is where we're strong

style: mandarin ballad, warm emotional piano, slow tempo, intimate close vocal, reverb, clear diction
lyrics:
[Verse]
你走了以后 房间很空
只剩窗台那盆安静的绿
我把你的杯子 摆回原处
好像你只是出门买包盐

[Chorus]
如果想念有声音
应该是窗外的雨
如果想念有形状
是桌上没折的信
